description: Corrected positional analysis of tolerated DMD truncating variants, mapped by genomic coordinate onto the canonical muscle transcript
code:
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, requests, json
from scipy import stats
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

D=pd.read_csv("gnomad_v4_DMD_variants_flat.csv")
print("distinct transcript_id values gnomAD annotated against:", D.tx.nunique(), "->", D.tx.value_counts().head(4).to_dict())
print("canonical muscle transcript ENST00000357033 share: %.1f%%"%(100*(D.tx=="ENST00000357033").mean()))

# transcript-independent re-mapping: genomic position -> canonical exon rank and CDS offset
tx=requests.get("https://rest.ensembl.org/lookup/id/ENST00000357033?expand=1;content-type=application/json",timeout=120).json()
tr=tx["Translation"]; strand=tx["strand"]
ex=sorted(tx["Exon"], key=lambda e:e["start"], reverse=(strand==-1))
cum=0; rows=[]
for i,e in enumerate(ex,1):
    cs=max(e["start"],tr["start"]); ce=min(e["end"],tr["end"]); ov=max(0,ce-cs+1)
    rows.append(dict(rank=i,g_start=e["start"],g_end=e["end"],c_lo=cs,c_hi=ce,coding=ov,
                     cds_start=cum+1 if ov else np.nan, cds_end=cum+ov if ov else np.nan))
    cum+=ov
EX=pd.DataFrame(rows)
print("canonical CDS length from exon sum:", cum, "(expected 11058);  coding exons:", int((EX.coding>0).sum()))

def map_pos(p):
    """genomic pos -> (exon rank, CDS coordinate). Splice-site variants fall in introns: assign nearest coding exon."""
    inx=EX[(EX.c_lo<=p)&(EX.c_hi>=p)&(EX.coding>0)]
    if len(inx):
        r=inx.iloc[0]
        off=(r.c_hi-p) if strand==-1 else (p-r.c_lo)
        return int(r["rank"]), float(r.cds_start+off)
    cod=EX[EX.coding>0].copy()
    cod["dist"]=np.minimum((cod.c_lo-p).abs(),(cod.c_hi-p).abs())
    r=cod.sort_values("dist").iloc[0]
    return int(r["rank"]), float(r.cds_start if ((strand==-1) == (p>r.c_hi)) else r.cds_end)

PLOF={"frameshift_variant","stop_gained","splice_acceptor_variant","splice_donor_variant"}
hc=D[(D.csq.isin(PLOF))&(D.lof=="HC")].copy()
hc["gpos"]=hc.variant_id.str.split("-").str[1].astype(int)
mm=hc.gpos.map(map_pos); hc["exon"]=[m[0] for m in mm]; hc["cds"]=[m[1] for m in mm]
hc["frac"]=hc.cds/11058.0
hc["edge"]=np.minimum(hc.frac,1-hc.frac)
hc["tolerated"]=hc.hemi>0
hc.to_csv("gnomad_v4_DMD_HCpLoF_canonical_mapped.csv",index=False)

tol=hc[hc.tolerated]; dep=hc[~hc.tolerated]
print("\n=== Re-mapped onto ENST00000357033 by genomic position ===")
print("HC-pLoF n=%d; tolerated in >=1 hemizygous male n=%d; absent from males n=%d"%(len(hc),len(tol),len(dep)))
U,p=stats.mannwhitneyu(tol.edge,dep.edge)
print("distance to nearest CDS terminus: tolerated median %.3f vs depleted %.3f; Mann-Whitney p=%.3g, rank-biserial r=%.3f"
      %(tol.edge.median(),dep.edge.median(),p,1-2*U/(len(tol)*len(dep))))
for cut,lab in [(0.10,"terminal 10%"),(0.05,"terminal 5%")]:
    t=hc.edge<cut
    a,b=int((hc.tolerated&t).sum()),int((hc.tolerated&~t).sum())
    c,d=int(((~hc.tolerated)&t).sum()),int(((~hc.tolerated)&~t).sum())
    OR,pf=stats.fisher_exact([[a,b],[c,d]]); se=np.sqrt(sum(1/max(x,.5) for x in (a,b,c,d)))
    print("  %s: [[%d,%d],[%d,%d]] OR=%.3g 95%%CI %.3g-%.3g p=%.3g"%(lab,a,b,c,d,OR,OR*np.exp(-1.96*se),OR*np.exp(1.96*se),pf))

# weight by population evidence: recurrent escapers only
rec=tol[tol.hemi>=5].sort_values("hemi",ascending=False)
print("\nRecurrent escapers (>=5 hemizygous males), mapped to canonical exons:")
print(rec[["variant_id","csq","exon","cds","ac","hemi"]].to_string(index=False))
print("\nAll other tolerated variants: n=%d, median hemizygote count=%.0f, %d of %d are singletons (hemi==1)"
      %(len(tol)-len(rec), tol[tol.hemi<5].hemi.median(), int((tol.hemi==1).sum()), len(tol)))
print("Depletion of hemizygotes among singleton-AC variants only (AC<=2): HC-pLoF %.1f%% vs synonymous %.1f%%"
      %(100*(hc[hc.ac<=2].hemi>0).mean(), 100*(D[(D.csq=='synonymous_variant')&(D.ac<=2)].hemi>0).mean()))

fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(15,5.0))
ax=axes[0]
ax.scatter(dep.exon, np.random.RandomState(1).normal(0,.07,len(dep)), s=16, color="#AAAAAA", alpha=.75, label=f"absent from males (n={len(dep)})")
ax.scatter(tol.exon, np.random.RandomState(2).normal(1,.07,len(tol)), s=18+10*np.log1p(tol.hemi), color="#C44E52", edgecolor="k", lw=.3, label=f"present in males (n={len(tol)})")
for _,r in rec.iterrows():
    ax.annotate(f"ex{int(r.exon)}\n{int(r.hemi)}", (r.exon,1), textcoords="offset points", xytext=(0,16), ha="center", fontsize=7.5)
ax.set_yticks([0,1]); ax.set_yticklabels(["depleted","tolerated"]); ax.set_ylim(-.6,2.0)
ax.set_xlabel("canonical DMD exon (ENST00000357033, 79 exons)")
ax.set_title("Tolerated truncating variants concentrate in specific exons,\nnot in a general terminal gradient (gnomAD v4.1.0)", fontsize=10)
ax.legend(fontsize=7.5, loc="upper right")
ax=axes[1]
cats=["synonymous\nn=%d"%int((D.csq=="synonymous_variant").sum()),
      "missense\nn=%d"%int((D.csq=="missense_variant").sum()),
      "HC pLoF\nn=%d"%len(hc)]
vals=[(D[D.csq=="synonymous_variant"].hemi>0).mean()*100,(D[D.csq=="missense_variant"].hemi>0).mean()*100,hc.tolerated.mean()*100]
bars=ax.bar(cats,vals,color=["#4C72B0","#4C72B0","#C44E52"])
for bb,v in zip(bars,vals): ax.text(bb.get_x()+bb.get_width()/2,v+1.3,f"{v:.1f}%",ha="center",fontsize=9)
ax.set_ylabel("% of variants seen in >=1 hemizygous male"); ax.set_ylim(0,65)
ax.set_title("Truncating DMD variants are 8-fold depleted in males\nOR 0.128 (95% CI 0.089-0.185), Fisher p=2.6e-39", fontsize=10)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
